title: Economics
description: ISC Class XI Economics: microeconomics foundations and Indian economic development.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Economics (subject code 856) (www.cisce.org).
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026 against the CISCE-copyrighted February 2025 Economics (856) syllabus document carrying the ISC Year 2027 heading and a CLASS XI section, read through its AglaSem reproduction because cisce.org returns 403 to automated fetches, with a Scribd copy as corroboration. Class XI prescribes Paper I Theory (3 hours, 80 marks) and Paper II Project Work (20 marks) across three units, all three registered below.

sections.title: Economics
sections.description: Three theory units: understanding economics, Indian economic development and statistics, plus project work.

chapters.title: Understanding Economics
chapters.blurb: Definitions of economics from Adam Smith to Samuelson, micro and macro economics, the basic concepts of utility, value, wealth and welfare, the basic problems of an economy, and capitalist, socialist and mixed economic systems.

chapters.title: Indian Economic Development
chapters.blurb: Parameters of development, planning and economic development in India, structural change after liberalisation, economic growth and development, sustainable development and the current challenges facing the Indian economy.

chapters.title: Statistics
chapters.blurb: The definition, scope and limitations of statistics, collection and presentation of data, measures of central value and dispersion, correlation, index numbers and the mathematical tools used in economics.
